items.title: US stocks with the highest debt-to-equity ratios: Birkenstock and peers
items.summary: Investing.com -- The US market’s highest-leverage names are posting debt-to-equity ratios from 1,000% to over 15,000%, with some carrying more debt than their entire market cap and holding less than 5% of capital in cash. That’s not just aggressive — it’s financial brinkmanship, and it puts these stocks in a league with Energizer and Birkenstock for capital structure risk.

items.title: Oil prices plunge as supply glut fears outweigh Middle East tensions
items.summary: Investing.com -Oil prices tumbled on Monday, with Brent crude falling as much as 4% after the International Energy Agency’s latest outlook pointed to a substantial global supply surplus in the fourth quarter, overshadowing persistent geopolitical risks in the Middle East.

items.title: U.S. diesel prices fall below $6 a gallon to two-month low
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. diesel prices fell below $6 a gallon on Saturday for the first time in more than two months, as declining crude oil prices and weaker seasonal demand eased pressure on fuel costs.

items.title: Colgate Palmolive (CL) Stock May Be 21% Below Fair Value Today
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive has treated shareholders to solid gains in recent years, and that raises a simple but important question for anyone looking at the stock today. Do the cash flows the business can generate over time really line up with the current share price, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying economics?
